recommended.title: Settings a viewer can actually change
recommended.acceptance: There is a settings screen, and every switch on it changes something real. Neither a screen nor an API exists today. REQUIRED: preferred audio and subtitle languages, persisted per profile and consumed as PW-0206's defaults rather than as a second policy. REQUIRED: a diagnostics and telemetry control that is honest about what it does -- telemetry-decision.ts already reports WHY telemetry is off, and that reasoning belongs in front of the viewer instead of in a details element in the player. REQUIRED: an about section naming the application version and the licences the installer must carry, which is where PW-0208's LGPL attribution obligation is discharged in the product. REQUIRED: no setting weakens a security or rights control; there is no 'allow insecure sources' switch and no way to disable the transport checks.
recommended.notes: PROPOSED FOR gpt-architect RULING, round 80. Created unowned as part of the WINDOWS PRODUCT COMPLETION phase board so the proposal is machine-readable rather than prose, and NOT claimed before the verdict.
